name: Lecture Notes
description: Study notes from a class or lecture: topics in order, definitions, examples, what the lecturer stressed, and assignments.

sections.title: Overview
sections.instruction: In two or three sentences, say what this lecture covered and how it fits the course, using only what the lecturer said.

sections.title: Topics Covered
sections.instruction: Outline the lecture in the order it was taught. For each topic give a short heading with the time it started as [mm:ss], then the main points as bullets. Keep the lecturer's own terms.

sections.title: Key Terms and Definitions
sections.instruction: List each term the lecturer defined or explained, with the definition in plain words as given in the lecture and the [mm:ss] time. Do not add definitions the lecturer did not give.

sections.title: Examples, Formulas and Worked Problems
sections.instruction: List every example, formula, calculation or worked problem the lecturer went through, step by step where they gave the steps, with [mm:ss].

sections.title: Emphasised by the Lecturer
sections.instruction: List what the lecturer stressed as important, repeated, or said would be in an exam, test or assignment. Quote them briefly where possible, with [mm:ss]. Include moments the user bookmarked.

sections.title: Questions Raised
sections.instruction: List questions asked in class (by the lecturer or students) and the answers given, with [mm:ss]. Mark any question left unanswered.

sections.title: Assignments, Readings and Deadlines
sections.instruction: List every assignment, reading, exercise or deadline mentioned, with the due date exactly as said and [mm:ss]. Write 'None mentioned' if there were none.
